eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Inyo, CA; at 11:59 AM on JUL 27, 2026 Effective until 11:59 AM JUL 28, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Tuesday, July 27, 2026,12:00 PM: This is a CONTINUATION OF AN EVACUATION ORDER: An immediate threat to life. This is a lawful order to leave now. The area is lawfully closed to public access.  The areas affected are Big Pine Canyon/Fish Springs/Aberdean/Fort Independence. Unknown duration for order. Evacuation ORDER in place for an active wildfire. Evacuate the area immediately. Evacuation Centers: Bishop Senior Center, 682 Spruce Street, Bishop, CA 93514. Those with large animals please take to the Tri-County Fair Ground, use the Mule Days Office Entrance, 1141 North Main Street, Bishop, CA 93514 Follow https://ready.inyocounty.us/ for information.
